name: Ames mutagenicity benchmark dataset
description: A curated benchmark dataset for in silico prediction of Ames mutagenicity.
reputation: A well-established and widely used benchmark in computational toxicology and QSAR modeling for predicting mutagenicity.
notes: Moderate-sized dataset with class imbalance and experimental variability; risk of data leakage/contamination across splits and saturation for some methods.
